description: This file defines a serializer class for the DateTimeOffset type, including methods for writing and reading DateTimeOffset values in a serialization framework.

classes.name: DateTimeOffsetCodec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IFieldCodec for serializing and deserializing DateTimeOffset objects.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a DateTimeOffset value into the writer, including DateTime and Offset components.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a DateTimeOffset value from the reader, reconstructing it from DateTime and Offset fields.
